input.summary: Add RevMed IP-infringement, breach-of-law and data-breach indemnity; narrow Sanofi's indemnity
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended RevMed's indemnity to third-party claims that its services, deliverables or licensed technology infringe intellectual property rights, to RevMed's breach of Applicable Law and to RevMed-caused unauthorized access to or disclosure of Sanofi data, and we narrowed our own indemnity to Sanofi-provided content and Sanofi's breach of Applicable Law, per our preferred indemnity position.

ops.text: (d) any allegation that the services performed or deliverables provided by RevMed under this Agreement or the RevMed Licensed Technology infringe or misappropriate the intellectual property rights of any Third Party; or (e) RevMed's breach of Applicable Law; or (f) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Sanofi's Confidential Information or other data of Sanofi caused by RevMed;
